purpose: Common automation/observation seam; not a substitute for external input or visible-output observation.
transport: UTF-8 NDJSON on application stdin/stdout; provider pipes are separate. Serialize stdout writes. Drain application stderr independently.

commands.state: Snapshot without full response text; execute on UI thread. No redraw, forced GC, allocator purge or cache cleanup.
commands.text: Correctness-only snapshot of input logical LF text, response logical LF text, UTF-16 selection start/end and composition status. Never poll full text for headline memory sampling.

set_text.text: bounded UTF-8 string; replace editable committed text through the native text control; correctness/stability preparation only, never a substitute for keyboard/IME tests

scenario.name: one frozen provider scenario; only while no request is active; applies to the next explicit submit

commands.show: Use the ordinary composer show/focus path. For stability only; hotkey latency uses external SendInput.
commands.hide: Cancel composition and restore committed text before hiding; do not cancel the provider request.
commands.submit: Use the ordinary submit path and text from the real input control. Disabled while composing. For stability/provider tests; keyboard correctness uses external input.
commands.cancel: Use the ordinary cooperative-cancel path; works with composer hidden. Never a normal child kill.
commands.shutdown: Use the ordinary application shutdown path, including provider teardown within the shared timeout. No forced collector or allocator operations.

state_fields.composer_hwnd: unsigned decimal string HWND, 0 before creation/after destruction
state_fields.input_hwnd: unsigned decimal string HWND, 0 if not allocated
state_fields.response_hwnd: unsigned decimal string HWND, 0 if not allocated
state_fields.request_id: current/last positive integer or 0 before first request
state_fields.request_count: total submitted provider requests including explicit retries; no automatic replay
state_fields.last_seq: last accepted sequence, -1 before any chunk
state_fields.response_utf8_bytes: current response bytes, excludes fixed history
state_fields.mascot_presents: UpdateLayeredWindow or actual equivalent presentation count, not request count
state_fields.composer_paints: actual paint callbacks; renderer/backend and caret painting coverage disclosed
state_fields.cache_counts: named measurable cache/resource counters, otherwise null with explanation

frame_received.receipt_qpc: decimal string recorded on LF receipt before JSON decode

canonical_cancel_driver: External harness waits for chunk_accepted seq49, then sends cancel command, and checks exactly one cancelled terminal with last_seq49. Next ordinary submit must retain the provider PID/lifetime.

output_per_vector.name: vector name
output_per_vector.frames_base64: actual reconstructed logical frames including LF

decoder_mode.rule: Feed each listed fragment to the same framing implementation used for provider stdout. Do not return expected_frames_base64 as actual output. Shared harness compares exact frames/rejection independently.

accounting: Control-mode threads, queues and allocations remain in the measured application total. Use identical instrumentation settings for all candidates and disclose implementation-specific hook overhead. App event timestamps are diagnostic until externally correlated with visible output.
observer_qualification: Pending real candidate windows. No headline timing permitted from these callbacks alone.
